documents.content:
Strategy mission baseline.
Strategy MUST publish recommendation IDs for planner traceability.
Strategy should reuse shared packet schema templates across projects.

Planner SHALL ingest strategy outputs as first-class context.
Teams can leverage common strategy packet validators to reduce drift.
Roadmap MUST stay in sync with quarter goals.

Research mission baseline.
Research MUST capture provenance for each external reference.

Planner should reuse shared research topic templates.
Research outputs need to integrate with planner context ingestion.
